meta.name: Minimum energy map
meta.description: MEASURE POWER ON, 2.5 V, supply limit 200 mA. Frequency map 100-3000 Hz (24 frequencies, 12 s, up at the start and down at the end); pulse map at 600, 100, 2000 Hz: ON 0.05-5 s at 20 % and 50 % duty, rest sweeps at ON 0.1 s and 1 s, each condition after a 10 s continuous reference, shuffled; burst at start and end.
